exposure: COVID-19 vaccination just before or during pregnancy
outcome: maternal admission to critical care or death
cohort: Women in Scotland with a singleton pregnancy ending at or after 20 weeks gestation.
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy is associated with an increased risk of preterm birth, very preterm birth, maternal admission to critical care or death, and venous thromboembolism, while COVID-19 vaccination showed no increased risk for any of the investigated outcomes.
followup_time: Up to 28 days postpartum (for neonatal death)
gest_age: Singleton pregnancies ending at or after 20 weeks gestation
